{{Quote|On Tython, you'd use a meditation chamber to achieve a "Susheer State" of serenity. But every culture has similar rituals&mdash;we'll make do with what Rishi provides.|[[Kutri O'a]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
A '''Susheer State''' was a mental state achieved through meditation that was used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to construct [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] during the era of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. A [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] would use a meditation chamber, or the present culture's equivalent, to achieve such a state and thus attune their mind to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]; such a state often resulted in dreams and visions of the past and future.
